app-script-story-time-section.story-time.nb: Fortellingstiden gjelder scenen i alle produksjoner og endres i hovedfilmen.
app-script-story-time-section.story-time.en: Story time applies to the scene in all productions and is changed in the main film.

app-script-story-time-section.story-time.nb: Karakterenes utseende (kontinuitet) regnes ut fra når scenen skjer i historien, ikke hvor den står i filmen.
app-script-story-time-section.story-time.en: The characters' appearance (continuity) is worked out from when the scene happens in the story, not where it sits in the film.

app-script-story-time-section.story-time.nb: Scenen skjer i historien der den står i filmen.
app-script-story-time-section.story-time.en: The scene happens in the story where it sits in the film.

app-script-story-time-section.story-time.nb: Velg scenen dette skjer i forhold til, så regnes kontinuiteten riktig. Uten valg brukes plassen i filmen.
app-script-story-time-section.story-time.en: Choose the scene this happens in relation to, so continuity is worked out correctly. Without a choice, the place in the film is used.

app-script-translation-import-dialog.sug.nb: Den innebygde AI-en svarte ikke. Koblingene bygger på reglene.
app-script-translation-import-dialog.sug.en: The built-in AI did not respond. The links are based on rules.

app-script-translation-import-dialog.sug.nb: Den innebygde AI-en foreslo koblinger for {length} usikre scener. Kontroller og godkjenn dem.
app-script-translation-import-dialog.sug.en: The built-in AI suggested links for {length} uncertain scenes. Check and approve them.

app-script-translation-import-dialog.tra.nb: Et ferdig oversatt manus (PDF, Word eller Fountain) kobles til de norske scenene og replikkene. Det norske manuset endres ikke. Kontroller koblingene før du lagrer.
app-script-translation-import-dialog.tra.en: A finished translated script (PDF, Word or Fountain) is linked to the Norwegian scenes and lines. The Norwegian script is not changed. Check the links before you save.

app-script-translation-import-dialog.tra.nb: {length} scener, {length2} koblet, {lines} linjer får oversettelse. Usikre koblinger er ikke krysset av – de lagres som usikre og kan godkjennes senere.
app-script-translation-import-dialog.tra.en: {length} scenes, {length2} linked, {lines} lines get a translation. Uncertain links are not ticked – they are saved as uncertain and can be approved later.

app-script-translation-import-dialog.tra.nb: Den innebygde AI-en ser på de usikre koblingene …
app-script-translation-import-dialog.tra.en: The built-in AI is checking the uncertain links …

app-script-translation-import-dialog.tra.nb: Samme norske scene er valgt for flere importerte scener. Bare den første brukes.
app-script-translation-import-dialog.tra.en: The same Norwegian scene is chosen for several imported scenes. Only the first is used.

app-script-translation-panel.translation.nb: Koblet automatisk ved import – kontroller og godkjenn.
app-script-translation-panel.translation.en: Linked automatically on import – check and approve.

app-script-translation-panel.translation.nb: Oversettelsen endrer aldri det norske manuset. Bytt til «Norsk» øverst for å endre hovedmanuset.
app-script-translation-panel.translation.en: The translation never changes the Norwegian script. Switch to “Norwegian” at the top to change the main script.

app-script-translation-panel.translation.nb: Den norske teksten er endret etter oversettelsen.
app-script-translation-panel.translation.en: The Norwegian text has changed since the translation.
